facts.business: Graviss Hospitality Limited operates the flagship luxury hotel The InterContinental, Marine Drive, Mumbai, and is developing The Mansion House (TMH) in Alibaug, with subsidiaries in catering, hotels and resorts, and restaurants.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Mansion House (TMH), Alibaug expansion is more than a capacity enhancement-it is an investment in the future of Graviss Hospitality. It reinforces our commitment to creating long-term shareholder value through disciplined capital allocation, strategic asset development, and sustainable growth. Subject to timely execution and prevailing market conditions, we believe this project has the potential to strengthen our market presence and contribute meaningfully to the Company's long-term growth strategy.

auditor.name: M/s. A. T. Jain & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter drawn to Note 51-53 regarding accumulated losses of three subsidiaries as at 31st March 2026; no diminution in value of investments and loans considered good of recovery. Opinion not modified.

key_risks: Accumulated losses in subsidiaries raising impairment concerns
Dependence on flagship hotel The InterContinental, Marine Drive, Mumbai
Execution risk for The Mansion House (TMH) Alibaug expansion project
Changing customer expectations and technological advancements in hospitality
facts.related_party_note: Interest free loans granted to three subsidiaries; investments in subsidiaries valued at cost adjusted for impairment losses.
